name: docbrain
description: DocBrain for coding agents: capture what a conversation worked out into your organization's knowledge, with the file it concerns and the facts it rests on, after one yes.

server_url.title: DocBrain server URL
server_url.description: Where your DocBrain server answers, for example https://docbrain.your-org.internal or http://localhost:3000.

api_key.title: DocBrain API key
api_key.description: A key with capture permission: create one with `docbrain token create --name "Claude Code" --role editor`. Write tools refuse a viewer key.
